Commander Reid Wiseman, pilot Victor Glover and mission specialist Christina Koch of Nasa, and the Canadian Space Agency’s Jeremy Hansen, have just become the first humans to travel to the moon, and return to Earth safely, since the crew of Apollo 17 in December 1972 ‘Just the beginning’: Artemis II crew

title: Artemis crew home safely after completing historic mission to the Moon
summary: Four astronauts splashed down in the Pacific after a nine-day voyage that took them further from Earth than any humans.
